title: Germanic Peoples, 5 dollars
descriptionPlain: Description Discover the Barbarian World Two ounces of fine silver Wonderful gift for a history lover Unique design rich with symbolism High relief and digital printing of the highest quality Germanic tribes, which from the 6th century BC shaped the history of Central and Northern Europe, were the foundation of today’s European civilization. Their military strength and migrations contributed to key changes in the political structure of Europe. This unique coin is a symbol of power and permanence. Struck in two ounces of pure silver, it constitutes an exceptional work of art and an addition to any collection.
